The `build()` and `package()` functions use standard CMake invocations to configure, build, and install the software into the package directory. All dependencies are clearly declared and relevant to the application's functionality (e.g., Qt, PipeWire, FFmpeg). There are no suspicious network calls, obfuscated commands, or file operations outside the build directory.

No evidence of malicious behavior—such as data exfiltration, execution of downloaded code, or unauthorized system modifications—is present. The package installs application files and integrates with the system using standard CMake install procedures. Upstream application behavior (screen/audio casting via DLNA) may involve network access and media capture, but these are expected functionalities, not supply-chain threats.
</details>
